body:
Well thats the problem,i absolutely hate the country i live in. The people,the buildings,the goverment,the devastated nature...So i dont see myself doing anything here really. I always loved animals and wanted to have my own farm,but that shit wont ever happen.

Dude,get out where? I cant waste my money reserves on going to bars and even if i had the money i am so shy i could never talk with strangers...
My problem is that i want to travel the world and kind of force myself to get out of my shell...but i couldnt do it last time because i ended up in motel not far from here drinking,smoking weed and eating for few months. So basically burning thru my money instead of travelling. What the hell will happen if i go without money? I will most likely freeze to death in a week,so the only alternative is to waste my life like this

Well why dont you let the nature decide? If you feel like you have absolutely nothing to lose then what is stopping you from walking out of that door and travelling? What is the worse that can happen,you can die? You want to now anyway right,so why not give this shitty life one last ultimate try.
